content.thinking: The earlier sed did partially apply ("%04x:%04x00"), leaving the trailing "00". Let me fix properly with a direct string replacement of "%04x:%04x00" → "%04x:%04x".

arguments.command: cd /workspace/scratch && sed -i 's/%04x:%04x00/%04x:%04x/g' t_random.py && grep -n "2001:db8:" t_random.py | head -5 && python3 t_random.py
